conviction_note: Two forces of similar size pull opposite ways: a company that raised at Q3 in each of the last two years and whose plan implies a Q3/Q4 profit run-rate (~281m) below Q2's 303m, against a stock up 40% in 20 days and +119% since late June. The latest leg (+25% over 9/29-10/02) came on a school deployment the company gives away free, the margin long is crowded (信用倍率 979x), and the two prior prints that followed +24%/+29% run-ups closed -16.3% (Q1, no raise) and +3.2% (Q2, a 57% OP raise that traded +17.7% in PTS and then gave it back). So abs_move is large (10%, against a true release-date median of ~13.7%) and p_up leans a little down (44). The findings sum (-1.2) and the scaled number (-1.2) agree.
bar: Company FY11/2026 plan, revised 2026-07-07: sales 5,650m, OP 1,100m, ordinary 1,130m, net 1,200m (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260707/140120260707588967.pdf). H1 actual OP 538m, so the implied H2 is 562m, or ~281m a quarter. There is no street number: kabuyoho/IFIS shows no analyst consensus and no rating (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=5243), and I could not reach 四季報. print_vs_bar is Q3 OP against that ~281m run-rate, an inference from Q2's 303m. Because the bar is the plan alone, sizes are capped.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.90% from one seller, up 0.02pts (as of 2026-09-29, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per baseline). Short covering cannot fuel a squeeze. 信用倍率 979x (kabutan stock page, 2026-10-06): the margin long is enormous relative to the margin short, so leveraged retail is crowded long. run_up_20d +40.3%, run_up_5d +18.8%. priced_lean_pct is -3.0, mostly the run-up and the margin overhang. There is no option skew in Japan.

findings.finding: The FY plan looks beatable and the company has a habit of raising at Q3. It raised the full-year forecast at the Q3 print in FY2024 (24/10/09) and FY2025 (25/10/07; the stock rose +22.3% to the next close), and at Q2 this year. The 7/7 plan implies H2 OP of 562m, ~281m a quarter, below Q2's 303m, while Q2 revenue was still accelerating (+36.8% YoY) and Q4 has historically been at or above Q3. Against that, on 8/14 management called the plan 'neither optimistic nor overly conservative' and guided H2 personnel costs up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY2025 with a raise: +22.3% (2025-10-07 close 1,344 to 1,644). Q3 FY2024 with a raise: +11.2%. Q2 FY2026 with a 57% OP raise after a +29% run-up: +3.2% at the next close (PTS had been +17.7%), then -12% the following day. Q1 FY2026 with no raise after a +24% run-up: -16.3%. Prices from the Yahoo chart; revision dates from kabutan's 修正履歴.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock is +40% in 20 days, and a raise is the obvious hope of a retail register at 979x margin. What is not in the price is the size: no analyst publishes a number, so whether the raise beats a 1,100m plan that already sits at ~49% H1 progress is unknowable until 15:30. If a raise were fully priced the stock would have held its Q2 PTS gain, and it did not.
findings.independence: The revision history is a separate source (kabutan 修正履歴, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=5243). The Q3 FY2025 raise is confirmed by that quarter's 決算短信 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/52430/140120251007569430.pdf). The plan arithmetic rests on the 7/7 revision notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260707/140120260707588967.pdf).

findings.finding: The latest leg of the run-up has no revenue in it. The stock rose from 3,190 to 4,100 (+28.5%) over 9/29 to 10/02 on the Himeji school-board adoption, yet the plan lets a board open note pro for all its schools 一括して無料で (in one batch, free of charge). That sits on a 40% 20-day run-up and a 979x margin long. The two prior prints with +24%/+29% run-ups were sold at the next close or the session after.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY2026 (2026-04-14): run_up_20d +24.1%, then -16.3% next close. Q2 FY2026 (2026-07-07): run_up_20d +28.6%, then +3.2% next close and -9.4% two sessions out. Q3 FY2025 (+7.6% run-up): +22.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up itself is public, and the baseline lean already carries it (-3.0), so this finding mostly agrees with positioning and is sized below the lean. What is new is the content: the catalyst that added ~¥17bn of market cap in four sessions is a free deployment, which a retail buyer reading the headline (FISCO, kabutan 動意株) would not separate from a paid contract. The FISCO copy does say 無料で開設, but the price move says it was read as revenue.
findings.independence: Prices from the Yahoo chart (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/5243.T?range=6mo&interval=1d). The free-of-charge wording is repeated in the FISCO item on kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5243&b=n202609300325). 信用倍率 979x is on the kabutan stock page (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5243). This finding and the sign of the lean draw on the same run-up.

findings.finding: The company pre-signalled a Q3 re-acceleration in note pro ARR: Q2's large campaign signed 140 net new contracts on 3-month free terms that convert to paid in Q3. The same FAQ says GENIAC AI revenue will land slightly below its 500m plan, which is pass-through and does not touch profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separable history. KPI lines have not moved the stock independently of the profit and guidance lines.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the company guided to it. It lands inside the guide, so it is sized near zero. It is filed because a visible ARR jump is the KPI that would support a raise.
findings.independence: The Q2 presentation (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260707/140120260707589041.pdf) says the same thing; it is the same company voice.

会社四季報 forecast: shikiho.toyokeizai.net returned a shell page with no numbers; search did not surface a 四季報 figure
A pre-released 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想の修正 before the print: none on TDnet/kabutan since 2026-07-07
Shareholder returns: dividend has been 0 every year and there is no buyback history; nothing filed
Insider selling since the CEO's sale of 2026-04-23: nothing new on kabutan's disclosure list

Monthly KPIs: note publishes no 月次
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: plausible. The company raised at Q3 in FY2024 and FY2025 and the plan implies ~281m a quarter against Q2's 303m, but management called it reasonable and flagged H2 hiring; there is no street number to beat. Returns: none expected (0 dividend, no buyback history). New-year guide: not at Q3; FY11/2027 comes in January. Quarter vs own 進捗率: H1 OP 538m is 49% of the 1,100m plan; last year's 9M OP was 50% of the full-year actual, but that was a turnaround year, so the comparison is weak.
baseline_tension: The negative agrees with the lean (-3.0) and the free control (-run_up), so it is sized smaller than the lean. The strongest positive the release could carry is a further OP raise on the FY2024/FY2025 Q3 pattern. I looked for it and filed it at +1.0. That, a crowded margin long and the run-up are why abs_move is large while the sign lean is mild.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 and open question 4: the negative rests on a public run-up; one Japanese case saw a run-in sized short rise 8.15%. Positioning finding trimmed from -3.0 to -2.5, and p_up moved from 42 to 44.
Rule 2: wrote the strongest positive (a raise) into baseline_tension; I had already looked for it and filed it, so no further change.
